newsitem.title: USA: One killed in Empire State Building shooting.
newsitem.headline: One killed in Empire State Building shooting.

text.p: One person was shot and killed on Sunday and seven others were wounded on the 86th floor observation deck of the Empire State Building, a police spokeswoman said.

An unidentified suspect was in custody and an automatic weapon was recovered at the scene. Details of the conditions of the survivors were unavailable. The shootings occurred about 5 p.m. EST (2200 GMT), the spokeswoman said.
The gunman shot himself in the head and is in critical condition at Bellevue Hospital, the spokeswoman said.
No relationship between the gunman and the victims has been established, she added.
The Empire State Building is one of New York City's major tourist attractions. Police said the area was cordoned off and emergency personnel were on the scene.
